senses.gloss:
कोर m. (-रः)
 1. Union with little or no motion, as that of the fingers
with another, amphiarthrosis.
 2. A bud.
 E. कुर sound, घञ् aff.

कोरक mn. (-कः-कं)
 1. A bud, unblown flower; any thing partially deve-
loped but not full-grown.
 2. A sp१ecies of perfume commonly
Chor.
 3. Another perfume, a berry containing a resinous and
fragrant substance: see कक्कोलक 4. The fibres of the stalk of the
lotus.
 E. कुर् to sound, affix वुन्.

कोरङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) Small cardamoms: see एला.
 E. कुर् to sound, अङ्गच् and
ङीष् affs.

कोरदूष m. (-षः) A kind of grain, (Paspalum frumentaceum.)
 E. कोर a
bud, दूष् to change, अण् affix; also कन् being added कोरदूषक
m. (-कः.)

कोरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Pounded, ground, comminuted.
 2. Budded,
sprouted.
 E. कोर and इतच् aff.
